---
title: "HDF5 Bit-Packed Digital Loading"
---

## Overview

`HDF5Loader` supports Wavesurfer-style bit-packed TTL datasets via `data_key` in the JSON config. Samples are read as `uint8` or `uint16`, widened to `uint16`, and passed through the shared binary TTL helpers in `IO/formats/Binary/common/binary_loaders.hpp`.

## Entry points

| Component | Role |
|---|---|
| `hdf5::load_flat_unsigned_array` | Reads flat `uint8`/`uint16` samples (1D or 2D with `sweep_row`) |
| `hdf5::get_identity_sample_count` | Shape-only sample count for identity TimeFrames |
| `HDF5Loader::loadBitPackedDigitalEventData` | `extractDigitalData` + `extractEvents` |
| `HDF5Loader::loadBitPackedDigitalIntervalData` | `extractDigitalData` + `extractIntervals` |
| `HDF5Loader::loadIdentityTimeFrameData` | Builds `[0..N-1]` from dataset shape |

## Dispatch

- `DigitalEvent` + `data_key` → bit-packed path; without `data_key` → existing `time_key`/`event_key` parallel-array path (unchanged).
- `DigitalInterval` + `data_key` → bit-packed path only.
- `Time` + `time_layout: "identity"` + `data_key` → identity TimeFrame via `LoaderRegistry`.

`DataManager::load_data_from_json_config` routes `data_type: "time"` with `format: "hdf5"` through `tryRegistryThenLegacyLoad` before inline binary TimeFrame handlers.

## Tests

`tests/DataManager/IO/formats/HDF5/hdf5_bitpacked_digital.test.cpp` — synthetic `uint8` fixtures for events, intervals, identity TimeFrame, and 2D Wavesurfer layout.
